relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: The ligamentum flavum thickness was positively correlated with the expressions of IL-1α, TGF-β1, and TNF-α (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: TGF-beta1
relationships.evidence_quote: the mechanism of TGF-β1 promoting ligament flavum hypertrophy lies in inducing fibroblast differentiation into myofibroblasts

relationships.subject: IL-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1α can enhance the synthesis of pain mediators prostaglandin and 5-hydroxytryptamine.

key_findings: Ligamentum flavum thickness and tissue positivity for TNF-alpha, TGF-beta1 and IL-1alpha were higher in LSS than in disc herniation and correlated with each other.
These measures discriminated mild, moderate and severe LSS by ROC analysis.
